An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''stratospheric freighter''' participated in a [[Battle of Ebenmal|battle]] against elements of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Ebenmal]] between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] delivered to Ebenmal eighty-five [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]], who overcame a force of more than three thousand [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]].
